indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Fell about 76 points, a fourth straight losing day.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Lost about 181 points after recovering from a much deeper intraday drop.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Dropped about 849 points, with Salesforce its worst member.

notes: Every S&P sector fell as a report of an outage on a classified NSA network added to jitters after recent tech glitches; software led losses, with Salesforce down about 9.5% and Intuit, Workday and Adobe also sharply lower.

Inflation worries persisted: import prices rose again in October and Fed officials signalled openness to further hikes, even though October retail sales beat forecasts with a 0.2% gain; the VIX climbed to around 26.
Nvidia closed down about 0.4% before its results, then beat estimates after the bell and rose as much as 3% in extended trading; Home Depot fell about 2.5% on weak guidance and a CEO change.
events: Wed 18 Nov, 22:00 Kuwait time: minutes from the Fed's October meeting are released.
Wed 18 to Thu 19 Nov: Anthropic is expected to begin trading on Nasdaq (reports differ on the exact day).
Wed 9 Dec, 22:00 Kuwait time: Federal Reserve rate decision; futures price a high chance of a quarter-point hike.

sources.title: Kiplinger: Dow dives 848 points as NSA outage wrecks tech
